verdict.rationale: Docs claim Gusto 'calculates and files taxes automatically' and handles 'tax configuration and compliance,' implying year-end W-2/1099 generation, but no doc explicitly describes automatic W-2/1099 generation or distribution to workers. Community evidence confirms Gusto does produce W-2s but reports a serious real-world failure (duplicate W-2c forms double-reported to IRS) with unresponsive support, undermining confidence in reliable automated delivery.
